title: 第 4 课 · 从原理图到面包板
summary: 一个固定的方法：原理图里的每个结点 = 面包板上的一条金属条。
description:
原理图（schematic）只关心“谁和谁连在一起”，不关心元件放在哪里。把原理图搬到面包板上，可以按下面 4 步机械地做：

【第 1 步：找结点（node）】
结点 = 原理图里所有用导线连在一起的点的集合。本题有 4 个结点：VCC（电源 +）、A（R1 和 LED 之间）、B（LED 和 R2 之间）、GND（电源 −）。数一数：每两个元件之间的连接点就是一个结点。

【第 2 步：VCC → 红轨，GND → 蓝轨】
电源 + 结点用红色 + 轨，GND 结点用蓝色 − 轨。原理图上所有的地符号都去蓝轨。

【第 3 步：其余每个结点分配一条空的金属条】
例如 A = 第 7 列（a–e），B = 第 10 列（a–e）。同一个结点的所有引脚，都插进同一条金属条（或用跳线连到它）。

【第 4 步：元件跨在两条金属条之间】
每个两脚元件连接两个结点，所以它的两只脚插在两条不同的金属条上：R1 一脚在 VCC 那条、一脚在 A 那条；LED 从 A 跨到 B；R2 从 B 跨到 GND。

常见错误：把元件的两只脚插在同一列的 a–e 里——两只脚被金属条短接，元件等于不存在。

检查方法：对照原理图，逐个结点问自己“这个结点的所有引脚，是不是都在同一条金属条上？”

en.title: Lesson 4 · From schematic to breadboard
en.summary: One reliable method: every node in the schematic = one metal strip on the breadboard.
en.description:
A schematic only cares about "what is connected to what", not where the parts sit. To move a schematic onto a breadboard you can follow these 4 steps mechanically:

**Step 1: Find the nodes**
A node = the set of all points in the schematic that are joined together by wires. This circuit has 4 nodes: VCC (supply +), A (between R1 and the LED), B (between the LED and R2) and GND (supply −). Count them: every connection point between two parts is a node.

**Step 2: VCC → red rail, GND → blue rail**
The supply + node uses the red + rail and the GND node uses the blue − rail. Every ground symbol in the schematic goes to the blue rail.

**Step 3: Give every other node its own empty metal strip**
For example A = column 7 (a–e), B = column 10 (a–e). All the leads of one node go into the same metal strip (or are connected to it with a jumper).

**Step 4: Parts bridge two metal strips**
Every two-lead part connects two nodes, so its two leads go into two different metal strips: R1 has one lead on the VCC strip and one on the A strip; the LED goes from A to B; R2 goes from B to GND.

Common mistake: putting both leads of a part into a–e of the same column. The metal strip shorts the two leads together, and the part might as well not be there.

How to check: go through the schematic node by node and ask yourself "are all the leads of this node on the same metal strip?"
steps: Nodes VCC and GND: battery + to tp1, − to tn1.
Give VCC a metal strip for R1: red jumper tp3 → a3. Column 3 (a–e) now belongs to the VCC node.
Node A = column 7. R1 has one lead in b3 (VCC) and one in b7 (A).
Node B = column 10. LED1's long lead goes in c7 (A), its short lead in c10 (B).
R2 goes from node B to a new metal strip: one lead in d10, one in d14.
Column 14 needs to go to GND: blue jumper a14 → tn14. Check against the schematic node by node: everything matches!
hints: Count the nodes first, then assign metal strips. 4 nodes = 2 power rails + 2 columns (here one extra column is used to connect R2 to GND).
A two-lead part always connects two different nodes, so its two leads must be on two different metal strips.
tests: LED on; node A ≈ 5.5V, node B ≈ 3.5V

tests.name: LED 亮；结点 A ≈ 5.5V，结点 B ≈ 3.5V

steps.text: 结点 VCC 和 GND：电池 + 接 tp1，− 接 tn1。
给 VCC 分一条金属条给 R1 用：红色跳线 tp3 → a3，第 3 列（a–e）现在属于 VCC 结点。
结点 A = 第 7 列。R1 一脚插 b3（VCC），一脚插 b7（A）。
结点 B = 第 10 列。LED1 长脚插 c7（A），短脚插 c10（B）。
R2 从结点 B 跨到一条新的金属条：一脚 d10，一脚 d14。
第 14 列要接到 GND：蓝色跳线 a14 → tn14。对照原理图逐个结点检查，全部对上了！

hints: 先数结点，再分配金属条。4 个结点 = 2 条电源轨 + 2 条列（这里另用了一列把 R2 接到 GND）。
一个两脚元件永远连接两个不同的结点，所以两只脚一定在两条不同的金属条上。
